title: Jujutsu Kaisen: About the Culling Game
original_title: 呪術廻戦：死滅回游 総集編
overview: A recap of Jujutsu Kaisen episodes 48–59, covering the aftermath of the devastating Shibuya Incident and the events leading into the deadly Culling Game. As the jujutsu world falls into chaos, Yuji Itadori and his allies face new enemies, shifting alliances, and the consequences of Kenjaku's grand plan. With powerful sorcerers and awakened players gathering across Japan, the stage is set for a brutal battle where survival, ambition, and the future of humanity hang in the balance. Carrying their convictions and burdens, Yuji and his companions enter a new chapter.
